test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many times has India **entered **the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup **(ODI) finals**?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three.**__

__
 
• Till 2021, India had made it to the final three times: 1983, 2003, and 2011.
 
• India has reached the ICC Cricket World Cup Final four times — in 1983, 2003, 2011, and 2023.
 
• **Won only two times.**
 
 
• **In 1983 India won **against the West Indies in Lords’
 
• **In 2011 India** won against Sri Lanka at Wankhede
 
 
 
• **2003 and 2023 India lost to Australia.**

• The International Cricket Council is the world governing body of cricket.
 
• It was founded as the Imperial Cricket Conference in 1909 by representatives from Australia, England and South Africa.
 
• It was renamed the International Cricket Conference in 1965 and took up its current name in 1987.
 
• The ICC is headquartered in Dubai, UAE.
